notes: Prompt delivery is ARGUMENT via -p: in headless mode any piped stdin is APPENDED to the prompt as context (documented behavior), so this adapter sends an empty stdin and the -p argument is the whole instruction. readonly maps to --approval-mode plan, which refuses mutation tools at the framework level - note Plan mode is not an OS sandbox, and on some builds it expects the documented policy/tool configuration; if plan is unavailable on your build, remove the readonly key and jobs will be rejected rather than silently widened. auto maps to --approval-mode yolo (auto-approves all tool calls). There is NO documented reasoning-effort flag and NO auth-status command (sign-in is the interactive /login flow or API-key env vars), so authCheck and effortArgs are null. Deprecation: Google has announced Gemini CLI stops working for Google AI Pro / Ultra / free tiers on 2026-06-18, directing those users to Antigravity CLI; paid API-key, Vertex AI, and Code Assist Standard/Enterprise access continues. Treat this adapter as legacy/sunset for consumer accounts. Config surface: .gemini/settings.json (including MCP servers) in the job's cwd applies to bridge jobs and is NOT bounded by the job's mode - see SECURITY.md.
